retained_sic: 7.2.73 prescribes sak to the ā-final aṅga, and iṭ, in the P-sic domain. Thus the sequence contains a root-owned s from sak and an affix s from sic; these must not share one owner.

second_dual.root_initial_s: ṣ by the inherited qualifying preverb across the augment

second_singular: The apṛkta īṭ of 7.3.96 triggers the iṭ-following s-lopa of 8.2.28; the resulting i/ī junction has the long vowel. This is why the retained-sic 2sg is asāsīḥ whereas 2du has asāsiṣṭam.
sic_luk: 2.4.78 licenses the distinct sic-luk branch. Its deleted-luk affix does not restore aṅga operations through pratyaya-lakṣaṇa (1.1.63). Keep the short path asāḥ/asātam/asām separate from the sak/iṭ/sic path.
closed_grid: With PG274–PG280, both declared cutting profiles have all ten Classical lakāras and all nine person-number positions, 180 distinct positions in all. This closes that finite grid only; derived stems, other preverbs/senses, voices and Vedic usages remain separate.
domain: The four inherited, sense-qualified ordered pra+ni / pari+ni P profiles. Unaccented Classical pause forms; no A-pada or yaṅ-luk expansion.
